text: The five lemma: given a commutative diagram with exact rows and five vertical maps α₁,…,α₅ where α₁, α₂, α₄, α₅ are isomorphisms, one concludes:
choices: the middle map α₃ is an isomorphism
α₃ is injective but possibly not surjective
explanation: Two diagram chases give injectivity and surjectivity of α₃; the sharp version needs only α₂, α₄ iso, α₁ epi and α₅ mono. It is the standard tool for proving a comparison map is an isomorphism, e.g. between long exact sequences.
